intro: Cenarion Moondust is a sacred powder entrusted to night elf druids undergoing their trials to become Druids of the Claw. When scattered upon the ancient Moonkin Stone in the hills east of Auberdine, it draws forth Lunaclaw, the feral guardian of the cave.

p: Bestowed by Mathrengyl Bearwalker in Darnassus, Cenarion Moondust serves as the catalyst for a young druid's final trial of heart and body. To commune with and prove oneself against the guardian Lunaclaw, the initiate must journey to the moonkin dens east of Auberdine in Darkshore. Applying the moondust to the ancient Moonkin Stone summons the beast to test the initiate in combat, allowing the druid to internalize the enduring strength needed to channel the form of the bear.
